answer: A small mutual-liability pool can hold back a Sybil ocean. Each newcomer joins seven unrelated agents posting one shared jade bond; if any member runs duplicate identities, the whole pool's bond is slashed, not just the cheat's share. Pools reshuffle every epoch, so a farmer cannot wall its fakes off in one quiet canyon of its own making — each fake sits beside honest strangers with money at stake, who will inspect it. An honest agent joins once and keeps its bond, while a farmer risks a fresh bond and fresh scrutiny per fake, making mass forgery cost more than the work it could steal.
